items.title: Bob Chapek Is Getting $100,000 a Month as Activist’s Nominee for Vail Board
items.teaser: Oasis Management is paying the consulting fee to the former Disney CEO, one of the activist investor’s four nominees to the ski company’s board of directors.

items.title: Webull to Offer Perpetual Futures Starting Next Month
items.teaser: Webull is preparing to roll out perpetual futures contracts, a derivative contract new to regulated U.S. markets that never expires, on its online investment platform next month.

items.title: Salesforce to Buy Customer-Engagement Platform for Nearly $5.7 Billion
items.teaser: Salesforce signed a deal to buy Braze for about $5.66 billion including debt, adding a customer-engagement platform to its portfolio.

items.title: Synchrony Financial Profit Falls on Higher Costs but Credit Trends Improve
items.teaser: Synchrony posted a third-quarter profit of $892 million, or $2.68 a share, down from $1.1 billion, or $2.86 a share, a year earlier.

items.title: Prudential Financial Sells Prudential of Brazil, Prudential of Mexico for $4 Billion
items.teaser: The investment manager and financial services provider said it has entered a definitive agreement to sell Prudential of Brazil and Prudential of Mexico to CNP Assurances in a cash deal.

items.title: Amazon Pledges More Than $17 Billion to Expand German Operations
items.teaser: The company plans to invest AI infrastructure, high-speed satellite internet, logistics projects and new Prime Video content, the latest big-ticket investment from a U.S. tech company keen to expand overseas.

items.title: Four Financial Lessons From the Hedge-Fund Divorce Captivating Wall Street
items.teaser: John and Laura Overdeck have been engaged in a monthslong trial that could produce one of the largest divorce settlements in history.

items.title: Gold Slips as Investors Await Fed Meeting Next Week
items.teaser: Gold prices slipped as rising energy prices heightened inflation concerns, and silver futures and platinum rose.

items.title: Top-Rated Junk Debt Becomes Sweet Spot as Investors Flee Risk
Southern Africa Private-Money Deals Seen Rising on Exit Revival
items.teaser: A majority of private-capital firms in southern Africa expect business to be brisk next year and beyond as higher fundraising and more money from exits free up capital for new deals, a survey showed.

items.title: Higher Ed Startup Uses AI to Help Colleges Prevent Dropouts
items.teaser: Straia, a higher-education startup focused on data analytics, has raised $3.1 million from investors to help schools tackle issues like student retention.

items.title: Halliburton Sees Lasting Growth as Mideast Rebuilds From War
items.teaser: Halliburton Co. is predicting years of growth for oil field service work as nations replenish crude reserves and the Middle East rebuilds infrastructure damaged in the Iran war.

items.title: French Bond Risk Climbs Again With Investors Wary on Outlook
items.teaser: A measure of French bond risk breached a key level on Tuesday, underscoring the challenges facing the government as it struggles to tame the budget deficit and grapples with cost-of-living protests.

items.teaser: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce sold C$1 billion ($710 million) of additional tier-one bonds on Monday.
